# LithosBridge

Renders CanonicalNotes and is the write-mostly MCP/SSE client to Lithos (WriteResult, dedup, LCMA wiring).

**Tier:** Core

## Public API

### `influx.canonical_note`
- class `NoteParseError` — Raised when a note cannot be parsed into a :class:`CanonicalNote`.
- class `ProfileRelevanceEntry` — One profile's relevance data for the ``## Profile Relevance`` section.
- def `render_profile_relevance_body` — Render the body of the ``## Profile Relevance`` section.
- class `Section` — One ``## <heading>`` section from the Influx-owned body.
- class `CanonicalNote` — A parsed canonical Lithos note.
- def `find_user_notes_start` — Return the byte offset of the ``## User Notes`` heading, or ``None``.
- def `split_user_notes` — Split *content* at ``## User Notes``.
- def `parse` — Parse a canonical Lithos note into a :class:`CanonicalNote`.
- def `parse_lenient` — Parse *text*, tolerating a missing ``# {title}`` heading.
- def `serialize` — Serialise a :class:`CanonicalNote` back to canonical note text.
- def `insertion_point` — Return the offset to insert a new section at its canonical position.
- def `insert_full_text_section` — Insert a ``## Full Text`` section at the canonical position.
- def `render_tier3_sections` — Render the four Tier 3 sections as markdown (trailing newline).
- def `insert_tier3_sections` — Insert the Tier 3 sections at the canonical position.
- def `drop_tier2` — Remove the ``## Full Text`` (Tier 2) section, keeping Tier 1/Tier 3.
- def `drop_tier2_and_tier3` — Remove ``## Full Text`` and all Tier 3 sections, keeping Tier 1.
- def `extract_section_body` — Return the trailing-stripped body of *heading*, or ``""`` if absent.
- def `carry_forward_section` — Copy *heading*'s section from *source* into *target*.
- def `upsert_archive_path` — Set the ``## Archive`` ``path:`` line, idempotently.
- def `replace_profile_relevance_section` — Replace the ``## Profile Relevance`` section body with *entries*.
- def `upsert_section_text` — Insert or replace a full section with *rendered_section*.
- def `graft_user_notes` — Graft the existing note's ``## User Notes`` region onto *new_content*.
